assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: Closed-book supervised exam. One A4 sheet of handwritten and/or typed notes double-sided allowed. This is a hurdle task in which students must achieve 40% or more (24/60) of the final mark.

assessments.name: Weekly progress evaluation
assessments.description: Weekly stand-up like meeting in tutorial marked by the tutor. This will be based on the progress in the group project. Best of 5 (2 marks max each) out of 7. Conducted in weeks 6-12. Marked individually. More detail will be provided on Canvas.

assessments.name: Early Semester Feedback Task
assessments.description: This is an individual, auto-graded quiz that includes multiple choice questions. It will be based on the contents covered from Week 1 to Week 3.
